text:
Simon (Support): P1 — MiraHealth activation flow failing at token exchange, trial customer stuck, renewal at risk in 5 days :alarm_clock:
Carla (CS): @Simon drop the error and steps taken. we should notify the customer and set a troubleshooting call within 4h :phone:
Simon (Support): error: `ERROR 403: invalid_grant - token already used`
Simon (Support): tried: rotated key, re-sent invites, cleared cache. last successful event: invite delivered, activation link returns 403
Jin (CSM): adding myself. i'll take renewal tracking. need owner + ETA for fix and whether we can offer a short extension
Priya (Solutions Eng): can we issue a fresh one-time activation token from admin panel? manual provision might be a DB flag + token issuance — lower risk than a deploy
Ajay (Eng Oncall): need correlation id and request ids. checking token service and KMS now
Simon (Support): logs excerpt: `req=0x9b3f token_exchange grant_id=abcd1234 status=403 svc=auth`
Simon (Support): correlation id: `cor-1795-mh-88`
Carla (CS): comms plan draft: 1) immediate note acknowledging escalation + ETA 2) troubleshooting call within 4h 3) temporary manual provisioning if safe 4) RCA and next steps within 48h
Jin (CSM): i'll draft the note. @Priya confirm manual provision requires only DB flag and token issuance?
Priya (Solutions Eng): confirmed: DB flag + one-time token. no code deploy if KMS unchanged
Ajay (Eng Oncall): KMS looks healthy. token service rejects reused grants. i'll attempt admin token issuance and monitor exchange. reporting back ~20m
deploy-bot: Deployment to `auth-sidecar` started by Ajay (Eng Oncall) — sha: a1b2c3 — rolling canary
Ajay (Eng Oncall): canary done. issued admin token for `mira-health-acc-77`. test exchange succeeded. Simon try activation on customer user
Simon (Support): trying now — activation succeeded for one user. re-sent invites to remaining seats
Carla (CS): next steps: 1) confirm all users activated in 2h 2) host 30m troubleshooting call to capture feedback and recording 3) offer 7-day trial extension due to friction (pre-approve?)
Jin (CSM): i'll offer the extension and update renewal risk board after call. @Carla please send the customer note, i'll join the call
Priya (Solutions Eng): recommend follow-ups: add E2E activation test to staging and an alert if `invalid_grant` spikes >3 in 1h for onboarding namespace
Ajay (Eng Oncall): creating incident ticket + RCA task — will post link here once created: https://redwood.example/incidents/INC-1795-mira (placeholder)
Carla (CS): customer note ready: "Thanks for flagging — we escalated and applied a temporary fix. Scheduling a troubleshooting call in 30 minutes and extending your trial by 7 days while we investigate." Posting in 10m unless objections
Simon (Support): no objections. include note to avoid re-clicking old activation links
Jin (CSM): on call — confirm permission to record screen for debugging notes
Carla (CS): confirmed. owners: Ajay (eng), Priya (SE), Jin (CSM). comms owner: Carla
Simon (Support): handing off: status=P1 escalated to CS, mitigation=manual admin token, customer call scheduled, trial extension pending, incident created
Carla (CS): thanks all — after call drop a short summary here for AMs to update forecasts :thumbsup:
Jin (CSM): will update renewal risk board post-call
Ajay (Eng Oncall): will post RCA link & timeline once analysis complete
Carla (CS): marking this as `priority: urgent-handback` in tracker. good work team :tada:
Simon (Support): thanks — handing over ongoing comms and renewal follow-up to CS
